name: Tokita Itsuka
source:
Kyousuke's niece and cousin to his daughters. She moves in to the Tokita household and does her best to do all the housework as payment for letting her stay. She begs to call Kyousuke 'father' and asks her cousins to call her as a sister.

She is the eldest of the Tokita girls.
